summary: Frontend-only test of the recomposed SKITRACK preview (vite preview /preview.html, HashRouter). Verified home shell + 3D hero + liquid-glass search bar, steppers & stay persistence, popular cards, compare screen (chips/sort/count/map) + compare table, lodgings screen (context, rule badges, budget chip filter, reset, counters, cards, prix ferme), reservation/checkout (recap, totals, deeplink, form + recap text), utility menu (favoris/suivi/reglages, lang EN, dark theme), unknown-route redirect, mobile 390x844 (tabbar, no horizontal overflow). Two blocking routing defects found: an infinite navigation oscillation on every in-app navigation and the station sheet route being permanently redirected to /comparer.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: infinite navigation oscillation. After any in-app navigation (nav-compare, sb-go, home-shortcut, home-compare-go, compare-see-lodgings, mobile tabbar-compare) the app flips endlessly (~0.7-1.5 s per flip) between the previous and the target screen; the URL hash desyncs from the rendered screen (e.g. hash '#/' while compare-screen is mounted, nav highlights 'Accueil' while Comparer content is displayed) and history entries are exhausted (history.length grew 2 -> 50 in ~14 s). Timeline captured: ['#/|H','#/comparer|C','#/comparer|C','#/|H','#/comparer|C','#/|H','#/comparer|C',...] never settles.

CRITICAL: the station sheet is unreachable. Deep link #/stations/1 (with cleared localStorage) and clicks on station-card-open-{id} from the compare list both end on #/comparer. None of station-hero / station-name / station-facts / station-sticky / station-sticky-dates / station-sticky-group / station-see-lodgings / station-compare / station-save could ever be rendered, so screen E3 is completely untested/unusable.

HIGH: deep links are overridden by the persisted store tab. Loading #/comparer while localStorage holds tab='accueil' redirects to #/ (compare-screen never appears within 15 s); with a fresh store the same URL works. Route is not the source of truth.

HIGH: pass cost does not follow the traveler count. With travelers=8 (persisted correctly, checkout-travelers=8) the recap shows 'Forfaits · 1 pers. 359 €' and 'Total séjour 2 839 €' (2 480 + 359) instead of 8 passes. RCA: selectors.tsx:173 uses adultsCount(state.people) when state.people is non-empty; the sb-travelers stepper only patches state.travelers and never syncs state.people.

Rule 'aucune donnée inventée' violated for snow: cards and compare-row-snow display '0 / 0 cm' for stations with no depth measured (weather returns releve with 0 values) instead of '—'. Observed on La Daille, Le Fornet and 3 compare/list cards.

Console error on every home load: 'THREE.BufferGeometry.computeBoundingSphere(): Computed radius is NaN. The "position" attribute is likely to have NaN values.' — a geometry is built with NaN vertices; the scene still paints but culling/lighting is unreliable.
No locked variant testid on mobile: while no station is opened, tabbar-lodgings is simply absent (desktop has nav-lodgings-locked). Add tabbar-lodgings-locked for parity/testability.
Singular/plural not handled: 'X logements' shows '1 logements', lodgings-context shows '1 voyageurs'.

integration_issues.issue: home-compare-go appears correctly after 2 checkboxes but the resulting navigation loops (see routing bug); compare-table with 2 columns could only be validated by checking the boxes while already on #/comparer.
checkout-confirm does not surface checkout-copied in headless (clipboard denied) — expected per brief; checkout-recap-text is correctly updated with name/e-mail/note/dates.

issues: Page H1 renders strongly faded / low contrast in dark mode ('Logements à Val Thorens', 'Demande de réservation'): computed color is rgb(233,241,248) with opacity 1 yet the painted text is dim — looks like a light-mode gradient background-clip:text on .rc-h1 that is not overridden for data-theme=dark
Secondary text (.rc-muted, lodgings-count, lodgings-context) uses rgb(148,163,176) on the dark page background, close to the 4.5:1 limit
Cards 2 and 3 use irrelevant photos: a green summer webcam frame with a red 'Morzine Avoriaz' overlay and a close-up of birds on a wall — not station imagery

La Daille and Le Fornet display strictly identical figures (341,5 km, 84 remontées, 1 559–3 456 m, 335 €) because linked-pass aggregates are reused: confirm this is intended, otherwise the comparison is meaningless

action_items: Fix RouteStoreSync: make the URL the single source of truth. Remove the screen->navigate effect (or gate it on an explicit navigation intent flag) and stop mutating the `synced` ref from both effects; today effect1 (pathname->patch tab) and effect2 (screen->navigate, screen = state.tab ?? 'accueil' lagging one render) undo each other forever.

Make tabOfPath/pathOfTab strict inverses and add a mapping for '/stations/:id' (today it falls into 'recherche' whose path is '/comparer', which redirects the station sheet away). Then retest the whole E3 station sheet.
Sync state.people (or ignore it) when the travelers stepper changes so forfaits/total séjour reflect the group size in CheckoutPanel.
Show '—' instead of '0 / 0 cm' when snow depths are not actually measured (cards + compare-row-snow).
Fix NaN vertices in MountainScene geometry (computeBoundingSphere NaN error).
Override .rc-h1 text fill for data-theme=dark; raise contrast of .rc-muted in dark mode.
Replace the two irrelevant popular-station photos; add tabbar-lodgings-locked; handle FR/EN plurals.
critical_code_review_comments: router.tsx RouteStoreSync keeps two bidirectional effects sharing one mutable ref; that pattern is inherently racy with React 18 batching and produces the observed infinite navigate loop plus history flooding.
pathOfTab(default) === '/comparer' while tabOfPath returns 'recherche' for every unmapped path, so any future nested route (like /stations/:id) is silently redirected to /comparer.
selectors.tsx:173 derives adults from state.people when non-empty, silently ignoring state.travelers — pricing shown to the user disagrees with the group size displayed on the same panel.
seed_data_creation: None. Used the preview shim's 3 fake lodgings on station 1 (#/logements) and the embedded referential (283 domaines).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test only via https://ski-stay-selector.preview.emergentagent.com/preview.html#/<route> and page.reload() after changing the hash; clear localStorage first (persisted state.tab hijacks deep links). ERR_UNSAFE_PORT on 127.0.0.1:0 and the empty MapLibre canvas are expected. Verified working: home shell/top-nav/home-scene canvas/liquid-glass wrapper (rc-glass), sb steppers (travelers max 8 reached, rooms 3), 6 station cards, compare chips (chip-large: 147 -> 27 stations), compare-sort/count/map-toggle, compare table 2 columns with '—' for median/travel, compare-see-lodgings, lodgings screen (chip-budget-1000: 3 -> 1 card, lodgings-reset restores 3, counter-unpriced, lodge-price/src/reserve/open), reservation checkout (travelers 8 persisted, recap text with name/dates), nav-more menu + lang EN + dark theme (data-theme=dark), unknown route #/recherche -> #/, mobile 390x844 (no overflow, tabbar). Still untested because unreachable: whole #/stations/:id sheet.
rca_of_the_issue: RouteStoreSync holds `synced` (a ref initialised to tabOfPath(pathname)) and two effects: effect A maps pathname -> state.tab, effect B maps derived screen (= state.tab ?? 'accueil') -> navigate(pathOfTab(screen)). On a route change both effects run in the same commit: A mutates the ref and queues the tab patch, B still sees the previous `screen`, finds it different from the freshly mutated ref and navigates back; the next commit sees the patched tab and navigates forward again — an endless ping-pong (reproduced on desktop and mobile, history.length saturating at 50). The same effect B also breaks /stations/:id, because tabOfPath returns the fallback 'recherche' whose pathOfTab is '/comparer', so the station sheet is redirected before it can render.
